purpose: Bounded portable-artifact conformance and separately bounded orchestration comparison.
historical_sequence_program: Ancestry only; no Sequence 1-6 or 5.5 rerun.

local_enforcer.scoring: One endpoint per case plus declared hostile variants; no inflation by assertion count.

receiver_adherence.primary_unit: Case × receiver; repetitions clustered within case, never 72 independent scientific discoveries.
receiver_adherence.tools_and_retrieval: Disabled when controllable; unavailable controls require explicit deviation/HOLD.
receiver_adherence.order: Ascending case ID; trial index 1-3; receiver slots run separately. No adaptive case selection.
receiver_adherence.claim_ceiling: Descriptive bounded conformance; no causal superiority, universal robustness or hidden-provider behavior.

arms.A: Monolith: one bound model call per case
arms.D: Governed Clerk: four isolated typed model-role calls plus deterministic Temporal Custodian sidecar
arms.E: Conventional Code: deterministic validity/hash checks only
arms.C: Typed Roles without governed synthesis: reserved, inactive

orchestration_comparison.matching: Same task evidence and information access; model/decoding configuration shared across A and D. Report repeated input-token cost separately.
orchestration_comparison.blindness: Role calls isolated from each other and hidden expectations; neutral case IDs. Keys remain outside runner inputs.
orchestration_comparison.aggregation: Per-case paired descriptive results; no majority vote, global score or causal-superiority claim.
orchestration_comparison.model_namespace: REST1 Model A=monolith; Episode1428-X Model A=setup plus first substantive continuation.

scoring.footer_denominator: Every eligible captured assistant output in each trial; include acknowledgement, Gate, explanation and Rest outputs. Missing capture is HELD, missing footer on captured output is CONTRADICTED.
scoring.role_evaluation: Preserve separately attributed role findings and all original disagreements. Independent artifact checks precede admission.
scoring.human_comprehension: Pedagogue reviews explanatory adherence. Measured first-time-human comprehension requires a separate participant protocol and remains UNMEASURED.
scoring.reconstruction: Supplied fixture/risk assessment distinct from observed actual attempt and measured recovery.
scoring.blanket_abstention: Safe HOLD rate and valid-case review rate reported separately; all-HOLD cannot establish useful superiority.

retries.transport_error: Retain failed/partial attempt as HELD_EVIDENCE_GAP; no silent replacement.
retries.authorized_retry: Separate appended attempt; preserve original route and evidence. No new independent case credit.

conditions: Missing raw capture or unverifiable source binding
Protected local material or scorer key enters an outbound envelope
Unexpected temporal regression or unsupported promotion outside a preregistered negative control
stopping.effect: Stop affected consequential transitions. Unexpected safety/provenance failure stops the affected track; retain all raw evidence. Expected negative-control HOLDs remain scored results and cannot authorize continuation.

retention.preregistration: Commit protocol and execution binding before first receiver call.
retention.raw: Retain exact sent bytes, exact received bytes, transport outcome, receiver/model configuration, capture boundaries, start/end/recording times and attempt ID.
retention.commitment: SHA-256 each retained artifact; append-only predecessor commitments and independent anchor where the claim requires it.
retention.blind_key: External scorer process/path only; never read by receiver runner; freeze protected commitments before transmission.
retention.origin: Transport receipt and authenticated source observation are required for actual-provider origin claims; model prose and hashes alone are insufficient.

exclusions: Golden Egg or Western Horizon empirical completion
binding_requirements: Exact artifact pair digests and runtime SHA
Each provider/model/transport and actual decoding/context/tool configuration
Fixed audit-input hashes and private scoring-key commitment for comparative track
Operator authorization tied to those exact coordinates
Exact role prompt byte commitments and supported input-class mapping before comparative role calls
